COMPILATION ENGAGEMENT REPORT

the balance sheet for QUADRO HOLDINGS INC as atJUNE 30 2025 and

Management is responsible for the accompanying financial information,

Related services (CSRS) 4200, Compilation Engagements, which requires
us to comply with relevant ethical requirements. Our responsibility is to
assist management in the preparation of the financial information.

required to perform procedures to verify the accuracy or completeness
of the information provided by management. Accordingly, we do not
express an audit opinion or review conclusion, or provide any form of
assurance on the financial information.
Readers are cautioned that the financial information may not be approp-
riate for their purposes.
Tommaso Di Paola CPA
